summary: Stage 010b unblocked checker versioning: /work/saivage-e2e-checkers is an independent clean git repository at HEAD 260fe981c66c67aa9b76d7b17cba8df6f756344c on branch main. The failed Stage 010 S9-S68 placeholder/static analyst scenarios are no longer in the default Playwright suite and are quarantined under e2e/analyst/quarantine, but the remaining analyst suite is only a one-test infrastructure guard; before a real Stage 010 retry, fixture code still needs removal of ambient .saivage auth/provider config copying.

findings.title: Executive summary
findings.details: The checker repository is now committable and clean, so the Stage 010a/010b versioning blocker is resolved. The next Stage 010 retry should be small and focused: delete/replace the unsafe ambient credential-copy fixture behavior, author real server-backed analyst scenarios, regenerate findings from observed behavior, then run the stage validation gates and ledger reconciliation. /work/saivage-v3 itself has preserved commits f85cf1ce and 5c6c9c6 with no tracked or product-file modifications, though many specification/research files remain untracked in the working tree.

findings.title: S9-S68 placeholder/static analyst tests are quarantined outside executable matching
findings.answer: Confirmed for executable matching. The default Playwright config ignores e2e/analyst entirely, and the analyst config matches only e2e/analyst/scenarios.spec.js. That file now contains a single guard test that checks the quarantine exists and does not contain the old placeholder patterns in executable source. The quarantined placeholder artifacts are present under e2e/analyst/quarantine/2026-05-26-stage010-placeholder-quarantine/ and are not matched by playwright.analyst.config.js testMatch.
evidence: /work/saivage-e2e-checkers/playwright.config.js:7-8 sets testDir './e2e' and testIgnore ['**/analyst/**'] for the default suite.

/work/saivage-e2e-checkers/playwright.analyst.config.js:9-10 sets testDir './e2e/analyst' and testMatch /scenarios\.spec\.js/, excluding quarantine files named scenarios.placeholder-stage010.quarantined.js.
/work/saivage-e2e-checkers/e2e/analyst/scenarios.spec.js:1-7 documents the placeholder quarantine; lines 15-16 point to the quarantine file; lines 18-25 define the single guard test.
npx playwright test --config playwright.analyst.config.js --list listed exactly 1 test: scenarios.spec.js:19 'failed Stage 010 placeholder scenarios are quarantined outside executable suite'.
npx playwright test --list listed 11 default checkers UI tests in e2e/checkers.spec.js and no analyst tests.

Focused S-label count found old S-label content only in quarantine/findings/docs plus one explanatory mention in current guard/findings; the quarantined JS file contains 198 S-label hits and quarantined findings contain 128 S-label hits.

findings.title: Ambient auth/provider config copying remains in the analyst fixture
findings.answer: Yes. The analyst fixture still copies .saivage/auth-profiles.json and .saivage/saivage.json from the checkers project into each temporary saivage-v3 project. This should be changed before a real Stage 010 retry because it depends on ambient ignored local config and conflicts with the project instruction not to read/log/copy secret/provider configuration as a work objective.
evidence: /work/saivage-e2e-checkers/e2e/analyst/fixtures/saivage-server.js:4-6 says real LLM credentials from the checkers project are copied in.
/work/saivage-e2e-checkers/e2e/analyst/fixtures/saivage-server.js:9 imports copyFileSync.

/work/saivage-e2e-checkers/e2e/analyst/fixtures/saivage-server.js:59-69 computes CHECKERS_DIR/.saivage/auth-profiles.json and CHECKERS_DIR/.saivage/saivage.json and copyFileSync copies both into projectRoot/.saivage/.
/work/saivage-e2e-checkers/e2e/analyst/README.md:12-16 documents the same copying behavior.
/work/saivage-e2e-checkers/.gitignore:3 ignores .saivage/, so the copied source config is intentionally ambient/unversioned.

exact_files_lines_to_change.required_change: Remove documentation and implementation that copies CHECKERS_DIR/.saivage/auth-profiles.json and CHECKERS_DIR/.saivage/saivage.json into temporary test projects. Also remove copyFileSync from the fs import if no longer used. Replace with a non-secret, explicit test configuration mechanism if the stage design authorizes one, or require the spawned server to use already-provided environment/model routing without copying secret files.

exact_files_lines_to_change.lines: 12-16, and related run requirements if updated
exact_files_lines_to_change.required_change: Update the suite description so it no longer instructs readers that .saivage/saivage.json and .saivage/auth-profiles.json are copied from the checker project. Document the replacement invocation contract for real analyst runs.

findings.impact: Leaving this behavior in place risks secret/config leakage through copied temp projects and makes test reproducibility depend on ignored local files. It is the main pre-retry cleanup item now that versioning is unblocked.

findings.answer: Commits f85cf1ce98cd9373d471ca597bfb510c94a6089d and 5c6c9c6f1521436d18a62a3c40745adb8bee74fc are present and reachable from the current master branch. findings.title: Smallest recommended Stage 010 retry scope
findings.answer: Run a narrowly scoped Stage 010 retry that treats checker versioning as solved and does not redo Stage 010b. The retry should only (1) remove the unsafe ambient auth/provider fixture copying and update README docs, (2) replace the current one-test analyst guard with substantive server-backed analyst scenarios required by the immutable Stage 010 design/plan, (3) regenerate e2e/analyst/findings/findings.md from observed behavior rather than static placeholders, (4) run the pinned Stage 010 validation gate including analyst-e2e through the cookbook driver, and (5) reconcile the expected-breakage ledger by appending new failures or deleting only resolved entries whose target fix stage is Stage 010.
evidence: Versioning unblocker is complete: e2e checker repo is clean at HEAD 260fe981c66c67aa9b76d7b17cba8df6f756344c on main.
Current analyst suite list has only one infrastructure guard test, so substantive coverage remains absent.
Ambient config copying remains at e2e/analyst/fixtures/saivage-server.js:59-69 and must be removed/replaced before relying on real scenarios.
findings.impact: This is the minimum scope that addresses the actual remaining blockers without broad replanning or redoing checker repository setup.
